newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINANCE, INTERIOR MINISTERS RESIGN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINANCE, INTERIOR MINISTERS RESIGN.

text.p: PRAGUE, May 24 (REUTER) - Czech ministers of Finance and the Interior, Ivan Kocarnik and Jan Ruml, have resigned from their posts, Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus told a news conference broadcast live by Czech Radio on Saturday.

Klaus said the ministers, both members of his Civic Democratic Party (ODS), would be replaced by economist Jiri Waigel, his chief advisor who is not affiliated to any party, and by Petr Necas, an ODS deputy and chairman of the lower house defence and security committee, respectively.
